manifest.name: STARBOX COFFEE
manifest.description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. A cozy cafe arcade with progressive Espresso and advanced Latte courses. Climb the glass tower from an oak counter, master slippery ceramic and solid ledges, take permanent timber detours, collect your recipe and outrun rising coffee. Milo, Mira and Perfect Coffee cards. Free play.
